audit: billabong.com/en-gb/size-guide 404s and billabong.com is now the US store; UK store is billabong.co.uk, guide only on product pages (same Mens Apparel chart on a tee and a sweatshirt). CM tab, ranges. Letter rows read by position: XS=28, S=30, M=32, L=34, XL=36, XXL=38 (numeric 28-38 are waist sizes; the unlettered 31 and 33 columns not stored). M 100/86 -> 101.5-106.5/80-85; XL 112/98 -> 111.5-117/90-93; XXL 118/104 -> 117-122/94-98. Hips added. UK/US/EU removed (not printed). The inch tab has slips (e.g. size 34 hip 44"-44" vs 106.5-111.5 cm); printed cm kept.
